questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Web Fundamentals, HTML5, CSS3, and Responsive Design
questions.text: Explain HTML5 semantic elements (`<header>`, `<nav>`, `<section>`, `<article>`, `<footer>`). Explain CSS Box Model (Margin, Border, Padding, Content), Flexbox, and CSS Grid layout for responsive web design.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Client-Side Scripting with JavaScript and DOM Manipulation
questions.text: Explain JavaScript Document Object Model (DOM) tree. Write JavaScript functions for Client-Side Form Validation (validating email, password strength, and mandatory fields) with event listeners.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Client-Side Scripting with JavaScript and DOM Manipulation
questions.text: Explain JavaScript ES6+ features: `let`/`const`, Arrow Functions, Template Literals, Destructuring, Spread/Rest operators, and Array methods (`map`, `filter`, `reduce`).

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: Asynchronous JavaScript (AJAX, Promises, Fetch API, and JSON)
questions.text: Explain Asynchronous JavaScript: Callbacks, Promises, and `async`/`await`. Write a JavaScript snippet using Fetch API to retrieve JSON data from an API endpoint and render it into an HTML table.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Server-Side Programming (Node.js/Express or PHP) and RESTful APIs
questions.text: Explain Node.js event-driven, non-blocking I/O architecture and Express.js middleware framework. Design a RESTful CRUD API (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) with JSON request/response payloads.

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Database Integration and Web Application Security
questions.text: Explain Web Authentication and Authorization: Session-Based Authentication vs JSON Web Tokens (JWT: Header, Payload, Signature). Explain Web Security threats: SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF, and CORS policies with prevention mechanisms.
